mapper.select: SELECT nur.id, nur.type, nur.news_id, nur.content, nur.been_read, nur.create_time, nur.target_uid AS senderUid, nur.uid AS recipientUid FROM b_news_user_record nur ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

SELECT nur.id as newsId, nur.type as type, nur.uid as recipientId, nur.been_read as beenRead, nur.create_time as createTime, nur.target_uid as senderId from b_news_user_record AS nur where nur.target_uid in #{item} and nur.type = #{type} and nur.uid = #{uid} ORDER BY nur.create_time DESC

SELECT nur.id as newsId, nur.type as type, nur.uid as recipientId, nur.been_read as beenRead, nur.content as newsContent, nur.target_id as targetId, nur.create_time as createTime, nur.target_uid as senderId from b_news_user_record AS nur where nur.target_uid in #{item} and nur.type = #{type} and nur.uid = #{uid} ORDER BY nur.create_time DESC
